zh.title: FlightAware控告Kalshi未經授權使用航班數據
zh.summary: FlightAware提告Kalshi未經授權使用航班數據結算預測市場
body: 航班追蹤平台FlightAware已向美國紐約南區聯邦地區法院提起訴訟，控告預測市場營運商Kalshi未經許可使用其數據與商標，用於結算美國航班取消數量的交易合約。
FlightAware要求法院核發臨時限制令與永久禁制令，禁止Kalshi繼續使用其數據與品牌。訴狀指出，FlightAware曾多次發送停止侵權函，但Kalshi仍繼續提供合約。母公司RTX表示，FlightAware未參與任何預測市場，亦未授權任何第三方使用其網路數據。
此外，FlightAware認為，連結航班取消的交易市場可能創造不良動機，促使他人故意干擾航空公司或機場營運，以操縱合約結果。

en.title: FlightAware Sues Kalshi Over Unauthorized Flight Cancellation Data Use
en.summary: FlightAware sues Kalshi over unauthorized flight cancellation tracking data use in US prediction markets.
body: Flight-tracking platform FlightAware has filed a lawsuit against prediction-market operator Kalshi in the US District Court for the Southern District of New York, accusing the company of using its tracking data and trademark without permission to settle bets on US flight cancellations.

The lawsuit seeks a temporary restraining order and permanent injunction to stop Kalshi from utilizing FlightAware data and branding. FlightAware stated it issued multiple cease-and-desist demands, but Kalshi continued offering cancellation markets. Parent company RTX noted FlightAware is not affiliated with prediction markets and has not authorized any third party to use its network data for wagering.

FlightAware also raised operational concerns, arguing that prediction markets tied to flight cancellations could create incentives for individuals to deliberately interfere with airline or airport operations to influence contract outcomes.
